items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I'd be right by the clarinet section, me and Omer Simcon and friend of -- we came up together on the clarinet

ctx.x: When did Elmer Simcon come up from New Orleans?
Simcon came back there because him and his brother went to school there, and they came up -- must have been in the early years because this was around 1922 and '21. We were going to high school.
Oh, I see. Where? Wendell Phillips?
